description: Escape the hustle and bustle with our most popular sailing trip-the half day sail! This charter kicks off with a leisurely sail along the intercoastal waterways to one of the best local shelling islands in Florida. Once at Shell Key, you'll have time to swim, snorkel, and look for shells before we begin our sail back to the marina.
